 Alex Waite · 31 October 2026 
 📉 United's PL defensive woes surface again as Blues superstars strike 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Michael Carrick and Man United are unlikely to get a respite from their recent downturn in form.
 The Red Devils came into Saturday's Premier League clash with Chelsea without a win in eight and that run looks set to continue.
 OneFootball Videos
 Chelsea 2 Manchester United 0 Today Full time After a goalless first half, Chelsea took the initiative and fired two early goals in the second period.
 High-profile summer signing Morgan Rogers continued his impressive output for the Blues with a deft chip over the onrushing Senne Lammens. 
 Morgan Rogers is living up to his €138 million price tag so far at Chelsea 💰🤪  –  Saturday, 31 October 2026 
 Cole Palmer doubled Chelsea's lead 14 minutes later, converting from the penalty spot after Lisandro Martinez was sent off for elbowing Wesley Fofana.
 Cole Palmer has scored 5 goals in 7 Premier League appearances vs. Manchester United. That’s also his 50th goal overall in the competition.
Inevitable. 👏  –  Saturday, 31 October 2026 
 The quickfire double compounded United's torrid defensive record under Carrick this season, seemingly upping the pressure on the Red Devils' boss.
 Only Crystal Palace (19) and Ipswich (16) have conceded more goals in the Premier League this season than Manchester United (15).
Relegation level backline. 🗑️🗑️🗑️  –  Saturday, 31 October 2026
